info.title: MCUAPI Documentation
info.description: This is an API with information about MCU Movies, TV Shows, Characters, and Timeline across the Marvel Multiverse. Supports content from Marvel Studios, FOX X-Men Universe, Sony, and other Marvel properties.

get.description: Reports API and database status. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable.
Reports only that the process is up. Does not query the database, so it stays cheap to poll and won't wake a suspended Neon compute -- used as Railway's healthcheck path.
Returns this OpenAPI document as raw JSON, for tooling and agents that need a fetchable spec URL instead of the rendered Swagger UI at /docs.
List all movies

get.description: Movies and TV shows merged into one paged, filterable collection, joined in Postgres via UNION ALL. Unlike /upcoming, undated announced titles (e.g. Blade) are included, sorted last under the default release_date ascending order.

get.description: Aggregate counts of the catalogue: movies, tvshows, characters, people, titles (movies + tvshows), continuities and designations. continuities is the distinct count over movies + tvshows only. designations is the distinct count over movies + tvshows + characters — Earth-838 exists only on characters (the Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness Illuminati), so titles alone would undercount it.
